root_idea.summary: The root centers on injury and its pain, while also extending to what is unmixed and to the emergence or extraction of something.
root_idea.development: The lexical evidence distinguishes three principal developments: wounding or painful lesion; purity or lack of admixture; and bringing something forth, especially water, growth, or an idea. Several specialized and figurative branches develop from these meanings.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The supplied Quranic noun is presented under its normalized lexical citation form.

senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran, the noun refers to an injury, especially in the context of combat. The lexical evidence also distinguishes the wound itself from the pain associated with it.

senses.definition: The pain resulting from a wound.
senses.usage_conditions: This sense is associated with the variant vocalization قُرْح reported for the Quranic passages; it is distinct from the wound or lesion itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To wound or injure someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form I verb synonymous with جَرَحَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be afflicted with a disease of sores or pustules.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported especially of camels or other animals affected by the disease called قُرْحَة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To confront or accuse someone with the truth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative construction meaning to address someone face-to-face with a truthful accusation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a horse or other solid-hoofed animal, to finish teething and reach the mature-teeth stage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The usage concerns the animal’s age and the emergence or replacement of the relevant corner tooth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a she-camel, to become visibly pregnant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term can refer to the beginning, manifestation, or evident completion of pregnancy, according to the cited authorities.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To break out in purulent pustules or sores.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said of a person, skin, body, or—figuratively—of a heart ulcerated by grief.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a horse, to have a white mark on the face.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The mark is the feature called قُرْحَة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To wound someone repeatedly or in many places.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II intensification of the act of wounding.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To prick or puncture a tattoo with a needle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The related verbal noun is also explained as pricking with a thorn.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of plants, to put forth their first growth or the tips of their leaves.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used of land beginning to produce vegetation and of the first emergence of a plant stem.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To face, confront, or encounter someone directly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verbal noun مُقَارَحَةٌ is used of meeting someone face-to-face.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause someone’s skin to break out in purulent pustules or sores.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The causative usage can also describe causing cattle or camels to be afflicted by the corresponding disease.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To prepare oneself to deal with someone or something with evil intent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported figurative construction; the simple pointer elsewhere in the entry adds no separate meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To dig a well in a place where no well had previously been dug or where water had not yet been found.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is commonly a well or water source.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of an arrow, to have its making begun.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized passive usage concerning the initial stage of manufacture.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ride a camel before anyone else has ridden it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of beginning something new.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To originate, invent, or produce something without precedent or prior hearing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It can refer to composing speech or discourse extemporaneously.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To choose, prefer, or select something for oneself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction extends to choosing a tune, song, friendship, or similar object of preference.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To impose one’s authority on someone or make an unconsidered demand.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The usage includes asking roughly, severely, or without consideration.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Purulent pustules, ulcers, sores, or small corrupt swellings.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a medical noun distinct from the ordinary sense of a wound; the evidence notes some disagreement about the vocalization and authority of this usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A severe mange or scab affecting young weaned camels.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Some authorities describe it as destructive and rarely survivable, while another authority considers this attribution mistaken.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The beginning or early part of a period.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of the early part of a person’s age and, in one expression, the first three nights of a month.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A state of having never been affected by mange, scab, or smallpox.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The state is described of a camel or a child.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Affected by purulent pustules or sores.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjective applied to a person or to the person’s skin.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A disease of camels involving purulent pustules in the mouth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The disease causes the animal’s lip to hang down; it is distinguished from ordinary mange or scab by some authorities.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small white mark on a horse’s forehead or face.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may be smaller than a غُرَّة and can have various shapes or positions short of the halter area.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A foremost, eminent, or distinguished person among companions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use based on the conspicuous facial mark of a horse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The first or beginning part of a season or period of rain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported of the beginning of the وَسْمِيّ rain, spring, or winter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person or animal not previously affected by smallpox, measles, pustules, or similar disease.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a singular, dual, or plural and to males or females.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Clear of an accusation or free from an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative construction meaning innocent, acquitted, or quit of the matter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who has not witnessed war.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of inexperience in battle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who has been touched by wounds.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is reported as a contrary meaning to the disease-free sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small white species of truffle or mushroom-like growth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The singular is also reported as قُرْحَانَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Pure, clear, or free from admixture.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Especially used of water not mixed with another substance, including water drunk after food.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Open, unobstructed land free of buildings, trees, or other intermixture.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term can describe land lying exposed to the sky, land cleared for sowing, or a broad even tract; the authorities vary in the exact environmental details.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Wounded or injured.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A participial adjective, also used substantivally of a wounded person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cloud when it first rises.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized meteorological noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The water descending from a cloud.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This denotes the water or rain produced by the cloud, not the cloud itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The first water drawn from a newly dug well or the first water issuing from clouds.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: By extension, it means the first or earliest part of a thing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A natural faculty for eliciting or originating intellectual ideas.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression قَرِيحَةٌ جَيِّدَةٌ describes a person with an excellent faculty for eliciting matters of knowledge.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person’s innate disposition, temperament, quality, mind, or intellect.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This broader psychological use is derived from the notion of what first emerges or is elicited.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who remains in a town or village rather than going into the desert.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may also be a nisbah to a place called قُرَاح.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The two flanks or sides of the body.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized dual expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A large internal object found in a horse’s belly, resembling a human head; in a camel, the stomach or ventricle that receives earth and pebbles.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The two animal-specific descriptions are reported under the same rare anatomical term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A smooth, bare, tall or elongated hill.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The description emphasizes elevation and lack of herbage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A tall, smooth palm tree with long bare lower branches.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized botanical description.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A long-legged she-camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The camel is described as walking as though upon spears.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A camel that avoids drinking with mature camels and drinks with the young.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized behavioral description of a camel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A solid-hoofed animal that has completed the relevant stage of teething.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Typically a horse or similar animal in or after its fifth year, according to the cited classifications.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The tooth whose growth or shedding marks the قَارِح stage of a solid-hoofed animal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It is the corner tooth next but one to the central incisors; four such teeth are described.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel or mare whose pregnancy has become manifest.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may refer to an early, evident, or completed stage of pregnancy, depending on the authority and animal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bow having a gap between its curved body and its string.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized object noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A lion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexicalized noun with no further restriction supplied in the evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A horse having a white mark on its face.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The feminine is قَرْحَاء; the term is also applied similarly to a common fly.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A meadow containing a conspicuous white flower or white flowers.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression also indicates that the meadow’s vegetation has appeared.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The bright face or emergence of dawn as darkness is stripped away.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative poetic construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The earliest ripe dates.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is linked to the appearance of marks resembling pustules on the dates; the transmitted form is noted as uncertain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Affected by purulent pustules or sores.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Of young weaned camels, it can denote one afflicted with the disease قُرْح or قُرْحَة, including camels with pustules in the mouth and drooping lips.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A road made conspicuous by the marks or tracks of people and animals.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of being marked or affected.

cautions: The QAC group is the canonical form قَرْح; the Quran-focused evidence reports a variant vocalization قُرْح in connection with the distinction between the wound and its pain. The packet does not supply a separate QAC form group for that variant.

The classical evidence contains reported dialectal differences and disagreements over several rare medical, animal, and botanical usages; these have been retained with localized qualifications rather than treated as Quranic meanings.
